a.name: Price slip
a.description: A torn-edge receipt pressed flat into a steel-100 panel, no shadow: five lines, a running rule, no total; two columns from 1024.
a.differs_from: A receipt sunk flat into a panel, with a running rule and no total; built strips are tiles, cells or ruled columns, plain, on a band or carded.

b.name: Figure sentence
b.description: The figures set inside one spoken sentence beside a 2x3 grid of the six puppies, each raised on a steel-100 highlight.
b.differs_from: The only counter strip with photos, and the figures live inside a sentence instead of tiles, cells or columns; every built strip is photo-free tiles.

c.name: Price scale
c.description: Figures as labelled stops on one broken number line, smallest to largest; the price forks into a boy or a girl.
c.differs_from: A number line that orders the figures by size with the price as a fork, not a row of cells; no built strip draws an axis or sits in an inset panel.
